# Cibara Comforts

> Budget hotel and lodge in Harihar, Karnataka, India. Clean AC and non-AC rooms, dormitory beds, free Wi-Fi, 24/7 reception, free parking, pet-friendly. Rooms start at ₹250 per night. 800 metres from Harihar Railway Station.

Cibara Comforts has served travellers, families and pilgrims in Harihar since 2016. The property is rated 4.6 out of 5 across 312+ verified Google reviews and is consistently listed among Harihar's top budget hotels.

Direct bookings (website / WhatsApp / phone) are cheaper than OTA prices because there are no commission fees. Payment can be made at check-in via cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), or bank transfer.

## Amenities

Free high-speed Wi-Fi in every room, free on-site parking (cars and two-wheelers), 24/7 staffed reception, daily housekeeping, hot water 24/7, ceiling fans in all rooms, AC on Premium rooms, flat-screen TV on Premium rooms, CCTV security, power backup, laundry service, pet-friendly, room service, safe for solo female travellers.

## Location and nearby places

- **Harihar Railway Station:** 800 m (10-min walk)
- **KSRTC Bus Stand:** 750 m
- **Harihareshwara Temple:** 1.2 km
- **Tungabhadra River:** ~2 km
- **Davanagere city centre:** ~15 km
- **Chitradurga Fort:** ~70 km
- **Hampi (UNESCO):** ~140 km

Harihar is on the Bengaluru–Hubballi route and is a convenient stop for pilgrims visiting Harihareshwara Temple as well as travellers heading to Hampi.

## Policies

- **Cancellation:** Direct bookings cancellable free up to 24 hours before check-in. Payment is taken at hotel.
- **Children:** Kids under 5 stay free with existing bedding. Kids 5–12 and any guest beyond 2 are charged ₹300/night. Cribs on request.
- **Pets:** Welcome. Small cleaning fee may apply.
- **Smoking:** Not permitted in rooms.
- **Long-stay discount:** 15% off for 7+ nights.
- **Group rates:** 3+ rooms get custom corporate rates and complimentary breakfast on request.
